title: Agent eval runner output
description: One runner output — the agent run for ONE case under ONE prompt-root, across N trials. The contract scripts/dev/agent-eval-score.py consumes: it diffs a base result against a head result (plan § Approach step 5). Emitted by scripts/dev/agent-eval-run.sh. Embeds a snapshot of the case so the scorer needs only base + head result files (no separate --case lookup) — though --case can override.

caseId.description: The case this result is for. Base + head results scored together MUST match.

promptRoot.description: The agent-prompt tree this run read from (--prompt-root). Base run vs head run differ ONLY in this path — that is the before/after seam (plan § Approach step 5 / RISK review finding 1).

harness.description: Harness adapter that produced the run, e.g. 'claude-print' or 'fake-runner'. The case/result/scoring formats are harness-agnostic; this names which adapter ran (plan § RISK review finding 4).

runMeta.description: Optional provenance. Timestamps/model are recorded for human triage only — the scorer never reads them.

promptRootRef.description: Commit SHA / worktree label of the prompt-root, if known.

case.description: Snapshot of the golden case (per case-schema.json) at run time. Lets the scorer read dimensions + referenceOutcome without a second file. Optional — a --case override on the scorer supersedes it.

trials.description: One entry per trial. The scorer averages per-dimension scores across trials.

output.description: The agent's full final text output. Piped to the external judge as {case, output, dimension}.

findings.description: Structured findings parsed from the agent output by the harness adapter. The inline objective checks (cited_file_line / severity_enum / finding_count) score these deterministically.

error.description: Optional: adapter/agent error for this trial. A non-empty error makes the trial contribute a 0 score on every dimension.
